feeds.title: Islamic Law Blog
feeds.description: The Program in Islamic Law at Harvard Law School is dedicated to promoting research and providing resources for the academic study of Islamic law. SHARIAsource is a flagship research venture of the Program in Islamic Law at Harvard Law School. Its continuing mission is to organize the world's information on Islamic law in a way that is accessible and useful, using data science tools and methods.
